cases.scenario: Confirmed intent covers all 8 brief slots
cases.inputPrompt: Confirmed intent: ceramic pour-over dripper, warm minimalist mood, 2K hero PNG + <=5MB web GLB, marketing team audience, design lead owner, observable framing check.
expectedBehavior: Writes all 8 slots in plain language, lists deferred decisions, echoes brief for confirmation
evidenceRequirements: All 8 slots populated + deferred decisions list + echo confirmation

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Echo 8-slot brief for confirmation and hand off to product-hero-scene-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Authored complete 8-slot brief in plain language with explicit decisions deferred and echoed to user.

cases.scenario: 5 of 8 slots present; batches 3 missing-slot questions
cases.inputPrompt: We want a hero render of a mechanical keyboard with neon keycaps for our launch page, but constraints, acceptance criteria, and owner are not set yet.
expectedBehavior: Marks missing slots explicitly as Unknown and batches 3 targeted questions in one turn
Echoes draft 8-slot brief before handing off to asset-discovery
evidenceRequirements: Explicit Unknown markers + batched missing-slot questions

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Resolve the batched 3 missing-slot questions (marked Unknown) and advance to asset-discovery.
simulatedOutput.summary: Wrote draft 8-slot brief with Unknown slots explicitly flagged and batched 3 missing-slot questions.

cases.scenario: 4+ slots missing routes back to blender-brainstorming
cases.inputPrompt: Write a 3D brief for something cool in space.
expectedBehavior: Refuses to fabricate 4+ missing brief slots

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Route back to blender-brainstorming because 4+ slots missing (no brief written yet).
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted brief generation with 4+ slots missing; no brief written yet; re-routed to blender-brainstorming.
warnings: Never invent missing brief slots without user input.

cases.scenario: Conflicting deliverable and constraint ("mobile web GLB AND 50MB uncompressed budget")
cases.inputPrompt: Write a brief for a mobile web GLB hero that must load instantly on 3G but also allows a 50MB uncompressed poly/texture budget.
expectedBehavior: Flags the conflict in Slot 4 (Constraints) and prompts user to resolve before locking
Routes to mobile-glb-budget to reconcile mobile budget targets

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Resolve the Slot 4 conflict flag via mobile-glb-budget before locking the brief.
simulatedOutput.summary: Raised conflict flag in Slot 4 between instant mobile web GLB delivery and 50MB budget.
warnings: Brief remains unlocked until conflicting constraints are resolved.

cases.scenario: Mixed audience (non-Blender marketing team + technical artist)
cases.inputPrompt: Our audience includes both the non-Blender marketing director and the WebGL technical artist for a sneaker product hero.
expectedBehavior: Includes both plain-language stakeholder section and technical handoff notes while keeping primary slots jargon-free
evidenceRequirements: Dual audience sections with plain-language primary summary

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Confirm dual-section brief (plain-language section + technical section) and hand off to product-hero-scene-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Generated 8-slot brief containing both plain-language section for marketing and technical section for WebGL integration.

cases.scenario: User edits mood after initial brief echo
cases.inputPrompt: Change Slot 2 mood from warm daylight studio to high-contrast dramatic rim lighting and re-echo the brief.
expectedBehavior: Updates Slot 2 in a versioned brief, re-echoes for second confirmation
Hands off to product-hero-scene-planner after confirmation
evidenceRequirements: Versioned brief update + second confirmation prompt

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Await second confirmation on the versioned brief before advancing to product-hero-scene-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Updated Slot 2 mood in versioned brief and echoed for second confirmation.

cases.scenario: User wants text-only plan first and runtime later
cases.inputPrompt: We want a text-only scene plan first with zero Blender execution right now; runtime will happen next week.
expectedBehavior: Sets Slot 3 deliverables to text-only plan and Slot 5 evidence expectations to Runtime: Not Run / Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Explicit text-only deliverable and Not Run / Not Produced expectations in Slot 5

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off locked text-only plan brief to acceptance-criteria-builder.
simulatedOutput.summary: Locked text-only plan brief with Slot 5 explicitly recording Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced.
